"""PreToolUse (Bash): git safety, append-only worklog, read-only brief, no secrets, clean commit messages."""
import importlib.util
import re

from _common import ROOT, deny, read_input

QUOTED = re.compile(r"\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'")
SEGMENT = r"[^;&|\n]*"
BRIEF = "Northwind_TakeHome_v2"
WRITE_VERBS = re.compile(r"(^|[\s;&|])(rm|mv|touch|tee|truncate|chmod|rmdir|Remove-Item|Set-Content|Out-File|Add-Content|Move-Item)\b|sed\s+-i|>")
SAFE_RM_TARGETS = (".venv", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache", "dist", "build")

RULES = [
    (rf"\bgit\s+add\b{SEGMENT}(\s-A\b|\s--all\b|\s-u\b|\s\.(\s|$))", "stage explicit paths, never git add -A, --all, -u or ."),
    (rf"\bgit\s+commit\b{SEGMENT}\s-[a-zA-Z]*a[a-zA-Z]*(\s|$)", "git commit -a is not allowed; stage explicit paths"),
    (rf"\bgit\s+commit\b{SEGMENT}--(amend|no-verify|all)\b", "no amend, no --no-verify, no commit --all"),
    (rf"\bgit\s+push\b{SEGMENT}(\s-f\b|--force)", "no force push"),
    (r"\bgit\s+reset\b[^;&|\n]*--hard", "no git reset --hard"),
    (r"\bgit\s+(rebase|filter-branch|clean)\b", "no history rewriting or git clean"),
    (r"\bgit\s+checkout\s+--\s", "no git checkout -- (discards work)"),
    (r"\bgit\s+restore\b", "no git restore (discards work)"),
]
SECRETS = [
    r"\b(cat|type|more|less|head|tail|Get-Content|gc)\s[^;&|\n]*\.env(\s|$|\")",
    r"(^|[;&|]\s*)(printenv|env|set|Get-ChildItem\s+env:)\s*($|[;&|])",
    r"\becho\b[^;&|\n]*\$\{?\w*(KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD)",
]


def commit_message_problem(cmd: str) -> str | None:
    """Same rules as the git commit-msg hook, applied to -m text before the commit runs."""
    if not re.search(r"\bgit\s+commit\b", cmd):
        return None
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("cmc", ROOT / ".agent/tools/githooks/commit_msg_check.py")
    check = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(check)
    parts = re.findall(r"-m\s+(\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*')", cmd)
    lines = [ln.strip() for p in parts for ln in p[1:-1].splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    body = [ln for ln in lines if not check.TRAILER.match(ln) and not check.TOOL_LINE.search(ln)]
    if not body:
        return None  # message comes from a file or heredoc; the git hook judges it
    if len(body[0]) > 72 or body[0][0].isupper() or len(body) > 2 or any(check.AUTHORSHIP.search(b) for b in body):
        return "commit message breaks the rules: one or two lines, first line lowercase and 72 characters or fewer"
    return None


def last_argument(cmd: str) -> str:
    return cmd.split()[-1] if cmd.split() else ""


def main() -> None:
    cmd = str(read_input().get("tool_input", {}).get("command", ""))
    bare = QUOTED.sub('""', cmd)
    for pattern, reason in RULES:
        if re.search(pattern, bare):
            deny(reason)
    for pattern in SECRETS:
        if re.search(pattern, bare):
            deny("this would print secrets")
    rm = re.search(rf"\brm\b{SEGMENT}\s-[a-zA-Z]*[rR]", bare)
    if rm and not any(s in bare for s in SAFE_RM_TARGETS):

            deny(f"{BRIEF}/ is the brief and data; it is never written")

        flat = re.sub(r"\d?>&\d|\d?>\s*/dev/null|&>\s*/dev/null", "", cmd).replace(">>", "")

        if re.search(r"\btee\b", flat) and not re.search(r"\btee\s+-a", flat):

    problem = commit_message_problem(cmd)
    if problem:
        deny(problem)

"""Exercise every harness piece in a throwaway copy under the system temp folder (never the real repo)."""
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

REAL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
results: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []


def check(name: str, ok: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    results.append((name, ok, detail))
    print(("PASS  " if ok else "FAIL  ") + name + (f"  [{detail}]" if detail and not ok else ""))


def run(cmd, cwd, stdin=None, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, input=stdin, capture_output=True, text=True, **kw)


def hook(tmp: Path, script: str, payload: dict) -> tuple[int, dict | None, str]:
    out = run([sys.executable, str(tmp / ".claude/hooks" / script)], tmp, json.dumps(payload))
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(out.stdout) if out.stdout.strip() else None
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        parsed = None
    return out.returncode, parsed, out.stdout + out.stderr


def denied(parsed) -> bool:
    return bool(parsed) and parsed.get("hookSpecificOutput", {}).get("permissionDecision") == "deny"


def bash(tmp: Path, command: str):
    return hook(tmp, "guard_bash.py", {"tool_name": "Bash", "tool_input": {"command": command}})


def setup(tmp: Path) -> None:
    shutil.copytree(REAL / ".claude/hooks", tmp / ".claude/hooks", ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
    gh = tmp / ".agent/tools/githooks"
    gh.mkdir(parents=True)
    for f in (REAL / ".agent/tools/githooks").iterdir():
        if f.is_file():
            shutil.copy(f, gh / f.name)
    (tmp / ".agent/STATE.md").write_text("# State\nNEXT: test\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp / ".agent/WORKLOG.md").write_text("first\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp / ".agent/TASKS.md").write_text("- [x] a\n- [ ] open task\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main"], tmp)
    run(["git", "config", "user.name", "T"], tmp)
    run(["git", "config", "user.email", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]"], tmp)
    for name in ("commit-msg", "commit_msg_check.py", "pre-commit", "pre_commit_check.py"):
        shutil.copy(gh / name, tmp / ".git/hooks" / name)


def test_git(tmp: Path) -> None:
    (tmp / "app").mkdir()
    (tmp / "app/x.py").write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(["git", "add", "app/x.py"], tmp)
    r = run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "add the first module"], tmp)
    msg = run(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%B"], tmp).stdout
    check("2 normal commit passes, message only", r.returncode == 0 and msg.strip() == "add the first module", r.stderr)
    bad = {".agent/x": b"a", ".env": b"a", "app/__pycache__/x.pyc": b"a", "app/big.txt": b"a" * 2_000_000}
    for rel, data in bad.items():
        p = tmp / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_bytes(data)
        run(["git", "add", "-f", rel], tmp)
        r = run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "add something"], tmp)
        check(f"4 pre-commit rejects {rel}", r.returncode != 0, r.stdout + r.stderr)
        run(["git", "reset", "-q"], tmp)
    (tmp / "app/y.py").write_text("y = 2\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(["git", "add", "app/y.py"], tmp)
    r = run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "add y"], tmp)
    check("4 pre-commit allows an app file", r.returncode == 0, r.stderr)
    (tmp / "Northwind_TakeHome_v2").mkdir()
    (tmp / "Northwind_TakeHome_v2/a.txt").write_text("a", encoding="utf-8")
    run(["git", "add", "Northwind_TakeHome_v2/a.txt"], tmp)
    r = run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "add the bundle again"], tmp)
    check("4 pre-commit rejects the brief bundle after the first commit", r.returncode != 0)
    run(["git", "reset", "-q"], tmp)


def test_bash_guard(tmp: Path) -> None:
    for cmd in ("git add -A", "git add .", "git add --all", "git commit --amend -m x", "git push --force origin main",
                "git push -f", "git commit -am x", "git reset --hard HEAD~1", "git rebase main", "git checkout -- ."):
        check(f"5 deny: {cmd}", denied(bash(tmp, cmd)[1]))
    check("5 allow: git add app/x.py", bash(tmp, "git add app/x.py")[1] is None)
    check("5 allow: git commit -m one-line", bash(tmp, 'git commit -m "add x"')[1] is None)
    check("5 deny: uppercase commit subject", denied(bash(tmp, 'git commit -m "Add x"')[1]))
    check("5 deny: three-line message", denied(bash(tmp, 'git commit -m "add x" -m "a" -m "b"')[1]))
    check("5 deny: rm -rf on a source folder", denied(bash(tmp, "rm -rf app")[1]))
    check("5 allow: rm -rf .venv", bash(tmp, "rm -rf .venv")[1] is None)
    check("5 deny: write into the brief", denied(bash(tmp, "echo x > Northwind_TakeHome_v2/data/a.csv")[1]))
    check("5 allow: read the brief", bash(tmp, "head -3 Northwind_TakeHome_v2/data/a.csv")[1] is None)
    check("5 deny: cat .env", denied(bash(tmp, "cat .env")[1]))
    check("5 allow: cat .env.example", bash(tmp, "cat .env.example")[1] is None)
    check("5 deny: printenv", denied(bash(tmp, "printenv")[1]))
    for cmd in ("echo x > .agent/WORKLOG.md", "sed -i s/a/b/ .agent/WORKLOG.md", "truncate -s 0 .agent/WORKLOG.md",
                "mv .agent/WORKLOG.md /tmp/w", "rm .agent/WORKLOG.md", "echo x | tee .agent/WORKLOG.md"):
        check(f"6 deny: {cmd}", denied(bash(tmp, cmd)[1]))
    check("6 allow: >> append", bash(tmp, "echo x >> .agent/WORKLOG.md")[1] is None)
    check("6 allow: tee -a", bash(tmp, "echo x | tee -a .agent/WORKLOG.md")[1] is None)
    check("6 allow: tail with 2>&1", bash(tmp, "tail -60 .agent/WORKLOG.md 2>&1")[1] is None)
    wl = str(tmp / ".agent/WORKLOG.md")
    for tool in ("Write", "Edit"):
        r = hook(tmp, "guard_worklog.py", {"tool_name": tool, "tool_input": {"file_path": wl}})
        check(f"6 deny: {tool} tool on WORKLOG", denied(r[1]))
    r = hook(tmp, "guard_worklog.py", {"tool_name": "Write", "tool_input": {"file_path": "F:\\x\\Northwind_TakeHome_v2\\data\\a.csv"}})
    check("6 deny: Write into the brief (backslash path)", denied(r[1]))
    r = hook(tmp, "guard_worklog.py", {"tool_name": "Write", "tool_input": {"file_path": str(tmp / "app/z.py")}})
    check("6 allow: Write elsewhere", r[1] is None)


def test_statusline(tmp: Path) -> None:
    sample = {"context_window": {"used_percentage": 41.2}, "rate_limits": {"five_hour": {"used_percentage": 23.4, "resets_at": 1900000000}}}
    out = run([sys.executable, str(tmp / ".claude/hooks/statusline.py")], tmp, json.dumps(sample))

"""PreToolUse (Bash): git safety, append-only worklog, read-only brief, no secrets, clean commit messages."""
import importlib.util
import re

from _common import ROOT, deny, read_input

QUOTED = re.compile(r"\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'")
SEGMENT = r"[^;&|\n]*"
BRIEF = "Northwind_TakeHome_v2"
WRITE_VERBS = re.compile(r"(^|[\s;&|])(rm|mv|touch|tee|truncate|chmod|rmdir|Remove-Item|Set-Content|Out-File|Add-Content|Move-Item)\b|sed\s+-i|>")
SAFE_RM_TARGETS = (".venv", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache", "dist", "build")

RULES = [
    (rf"\bgit\s+add\b{SEGMENT}(\s-A\b|\s--all\b|\s-u\b|\s\.(\s|$))", "stage explicit paths, never git add -A, --all, -u or ."),
    (rf"\bgit\s+commit\b{SEGMENT}\s-[a-zA-Z]*a[a-zA-Z]*(\s|$)", "git commit -a is not allowed; stage explicit paths"),
    (rf"\bgit\s+commit\b{SEGMENT}--(amend|no-verify|all)\b", "no amend, no --no-verify, no commit --all"),
    (rf"\bgit\s+push\b{SEGMENT}(\s-f\b|--force)", "no force push"),
    (r"\bgit\s+reset\b[^;&|\n]*--hard", "no git reset --hard"),
    (r"\bgit\s+(rebase|filter-branch|clean)\b", "no history rewriting or git clean"),
    (r"\bgit\s+checkout\s+--\s", "no git checkout -- (discards work)"),
    (r"\bgit\s+restore\b", "no git restore (discards work)"),
]
SECRETS = [
    r"\b(cat|type|more|less|head|tail|Get-Content|gc)\s[^;&|\n]*\.env(\s|$|\")",
    r"(^|[;&|]\s*)(printenv|env|set|Get-ChildItem\s+env:)\s*($|[;&|])",
    r"\becho\b[^;&|\n]*\$\{?\w*(KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD)",
]


def commit_message_problem(cmd: str) -> str | None:
    """Same rules as the git commit-msg hook, applied to -m text before the commit runs."""
    if not re.search(r"\bgit\s+commit\b", cmd):
        return None
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("cmc", ROOT / ".agent/tools/githooks/commit_msg_check.py")
    check = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(check)
    parts = re.findall(r"-m\s+(\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*')", cmd)
    lines = [ln.strip() for p in parts for ln in p[1:-1].splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    body = [ln for ln in lines if not check.TRAILER.match(ln) and not check.TOOL_LINE.search(ln)]
    if not body:
        return None  # message comes from a file or heredoc; the git hook judges it
    if len(body[0]) > 72 or body[0][0].isupper() or len(body) > 2 or any(check.AUTHORSHIP.search(b) for b in body):
        return "commit message breaks the rules: one or two lines, first line lowercase and 72 characters or fewer"
    return None


def main() -> None:
    cmd = str(read_input().get("tool_input", {}).get("command", ""))
    bare = QUOTED.sub('""', cmd)
    for pattern, reason in RULES:
        if re.search(pattern, bare):
            deny(reason)
    for pattern in SECRETS:
        if re.search(pattern, bare):
            deny("this would print secrets")
    rm = re.search(rf"\brm\b{SEGMENT}\s-[a-zA-Z]*[rR]", bare)
    if rm and not any(s in bare for s in SAFE_RM_TARGETS):
        deny("recursive rm is only allowed for .venv and caches")
    if BRIEF in cmd:
        if re.search(rf"\b(cp|Copy-Item)\b{SEGMENT}{BRIEF}\S*\s*$", cmd) or WRITE_VERBS.search(QUOTED.sub("", cmd)):
            deny(f"{BRIEF}/ is the brief and data; it is never written")
    if "WORKLOG.md" in cmd:
        flat = re.sub(r"\d?>&\d|\d?>\s*/dev/null|&>\s*/dev/null", "", cmd).replace(">>", "")
        if ">" in flat or re.search(r"sed\s+-i|\btruncate\b|\bmv\b|\brm\b|Remove-Item|Clear-Content|Set-Content", flat):
            deny("WORKLOG.md is append-only: use >> only")
        if re.search(r"\btee\b", flat) and not re.search(r"\btee\s+-a", flat):
            deny("WORKLOG.md is append-only: tee needs -a")
    problem = commit_message_problem(cmd)
    if problem:
        deny(problem)


main()

"""Exercise every harness piece in a throwaway copy under the system temp folder (never the real repo)."""
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

REAL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
results: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []


def check(name: str, ok: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    results.append((name, ok, detail))
    print(("PASS  " if ok else "FAIL  ") + name + (f"  [{detail}]" if detail and not ok else ""))


def run(cmd, cwd, stdin=None, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, input=stdin, capture_output=True, text=True, **kw)


def hook(tmp: Path, script: str, payload: dict) -> tuple[int, dict | None, str]:
    out = run([sys.executable, str(tmp / ".claude/hooks" / script)], tmp, json.dumps(payload))
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(out.stdout) if out.stdout.strip() else None
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        parsed = None
    return out.returncode, parsed, out.stdout + out.stderr


def denied(parsed) -> bool:
    return bool(parsed) and parsed.get("hookSpecificOutput", {}).get("permissionDecision") == "deny"


def bash(tmp: Path, command: str):
    return hook(tmp, "guard_bash.py", {"tool_name": "Bash", "tool_input": {"command": command}})


def setup(tmp: Path) -> None:
    shutil.copytree(REAL / ".claude/hooks", tmp / ".claude/hooks", ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
    gh = tmp / ".agent/tools/githooks"
    gh.mkdir(parents=True)
    for f in (REAL / ".agent/tools/githooks").iterdir():
        if f.is_file():
            shutil.copy(f, gh / f.name)
    (tmp / ".agent/STATE.md").write_text("# State\nNEXT: test\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp / ".agent/WORKLOG.md").write_text("first\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp / ".agent/TASKS.md").write_text("- [x] a\n- [ ] open task\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main"], tmp)
    run(["git", "config", "user.name", "T"], tmp)
    run(["git", "config", "user.email", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]"], tmp)
    for name in ("commit-msg", "commit_msg_check.py", "pre-commit", "pre_commit_check.py"):
        shutil.copy(gh / name, tmp / ".git/hooks" / name)


def test_git(tmp: Path) -> None:
    (tmp / "app").mkdir()
    (tmp / "app/x.py").write_text("x = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(["git", "add", "app/x.py"], tmp)
    r = run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "add the first module"], tmp)
    msg = run(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%B"], tmp).stdout
    check("2 normal commit passes, message only", r.returncode == 0 and msg.strip() == "add the first module", r.stderr)
    bad = {".agent/x": b"a", ".env": b"a", "app/__pycache__/x.pyc": b"a", "app/big.txt": b"a" * 2_000_000}
    for rel, data in bad.items():
        p = tmp / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_bytes(data)
        run(["git", "add", "-f", rel], tmp)
        r = run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "add something"], tmp)
        check(f"4 pre-commit rejects {rel}", r.returncode != 0, r.stdout + r.stderr)
        run(["git", "reset", "-q"], tmp)
    (tmp / "app/y.py").write_text("y = 2\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(["git", "add", "app/y.py"], tmp)
    r = run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "add y"], tmp)
    check("4 pre-commit allows an app file", r.returncode == 0, r.stderr)
    (tmp / "Northwind_TakeHome_v2").mkdir()
    (tmp / "Northwind_TakeHome_v2/a.txt").write_text("a", encoding="utf-8")
    run(["git", "add", "Northwind_TakeHome_v2/a.txt"], tmp)
    r = run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "add the bundle again"], tmp)
    check("4 pre-commit rejects the brief bundle after the first commit", r.returncode != 0)
    run(["git", "reset", "-q"], tmp)


def test_bash_guard(tmp: Path) -> None:
    for cmd in ("git add -A", "git add .", "git add --all", "git commit --amend -m x", "git push --force origin main",
                "git push -f", "git commit -am x", "git reset --hard HEAD~1", "git rebase main", "git checkout -- ."):
        check(f"5 deny: {cmd}", denied(bash(tmp, cmd)[1]))
    check("5 allow: git add app/x.py", bash(tmp, "git add app/x.py")[1] is None)
    check("5 allow: git commit -m one-line", bash(tmp, 'git commit -m "add x"')[1] is None)
    check("5 deny: uppercase commit subject", denied(bash(tmp, 'git commit -m "Add x"')[1]))
    check("5 deny: three-line message", denied(bash(tmp, 'git commit -m "add x" -m "a" -m "b"')[1]))
    check("5 deny: rm -rf on a source folder", denied(bash(tmp, "rm -rf app")[1]))
    check("5 allow: rm -rf .venv", bash(tmp, "rm -rf .venv")[1] is None)
    check("5 deny: write into the brief", denied(bash(tmp, "echo x > Northwind_TakeHome_v2/data/a.csv")[1]))
    check("5 allow: read the brief", bash(tmp, "head -3 Northwind_TakeHome_v2/data/a.csv")[1] is None)
    check("5 deny: cat .env", denied(bash(tmp, "cat .env")[1]))
    check("5 allow: cat .env.example", bash(tmp, "cat .env.example")[1] is None)
    check("5 deny: printenv", denied(bash(tmp, "printenv")[1]))
    for cmd in ("echo x > .agent/WORKLOG.md", "sed -i s/a/b/ .agent/WORKLOG.md", "truncate -s 0 .agent/WORKLOG.md",
                "mv .agent/WORKLOG.md /tmp/w", "rm .agent/WORKLOG.md", "echo x | tee .agent/WORKLOG.md"):
        check(f"6 deny: {cmd}", denied(bash(tmp, cmd)[1]))
    check("6 allow: >> append", bash(tmp, "echo x >> .agent/WORKLOG.md")[1] is None)
    check("6 allow: tee -a", bash(tmp, "echo x | tee -a .agent/WORKLOG.md")[1] is None)
    check("6 allow: tail with 2>&1", bash(tmp, "tail -60 .agent/WORKLOG.md 2>&1")[1] is None)
    wl = str(tmp / ".agent/WORKLOG.md")
    for tool in ("Write", "Edit"):
        r = hook(tmp, "guard_worklog.py", {"tool_name": tool, "tool_input": {"file_path": wl}})
        check(f"6 deny: {tool} tool on WORKLOG", denied(r[1]))
    r = hook(tmp, "guard_worklog.py", {"tool_name": "Write", "tool_input": {"file_path": "F:\\x\\Northwind_TakeHome_v2\\data\\a.csv"}})
    check("6 deny: Write into the brief (backslash path)", denied(r[1]))
    r = hook(tmp, "guard_worklog.py", {"tool_name": "Write", "tool_input": {"file_path": str(tmp / "app/z.py")}})
    check("6 allow: Write elsewhere", r[1] is None)


def test_statusline(tmp: Path) -> None:
    sample = {"context_window": {"used_percentage": 41.2}, "rate_limits": {"five_hour": {"used_percentage": 23.4, "resets_at": 1900000000}}}
    out = run([sys.executable, str(tmp / ".claude/hooks/statusline.py")], tmp, json.dumps(sample))
    usage = json.loads((tmp / ".agent/usage.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    ok = usage["five_hour_pct"] == 23.4 and usage["ctx_pct"] == 41.2 and out.stdout.strip() == "ctx 41% | 5h 23%"
    check("7 statusline writes usage.json and prints one line", ok, out.stdout + str(usage))
    out = run([sys.executable, str(tmp / ".claude/hooks/statusline.py")], tmp, "{}")
    usage = json.loads((tmp / ".agent/usage.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    check("7 statusline with no rate_limits gives nulls", usage["five_hour_pct"] is None and out.returncode == 0)


def put_usage(tmp: Path, pct, age=0) -> None:
    (tmp / ".agent/usage.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"five_hour_pct": pct, "five_hour_resets_at": int(time.time()) + 3600, "ctx_pct": 10, "updated_at": int(time.time()) - age}), encoding="utf-8")


def test_usage_guard(tmp: Path) -> None:
    probe = {"tool_name": "Bash", "tool_input": {"command": "python -c pass"}}
    put_usage(tmp, 89)
    check("9 89% allows", hook(tmp, "guard_usage.py", probe)[1] is None)
    put_usage(tmp, 91)
    check("9 91% denies other work", denied(hook(tmp, "guard_usage.py", probe)[1]))
    check("9 91% still allows git status", hook(tmp, "guard_usage.py", {"tool_name": "Bash", "tool_input": {"command": "git status --short"}})[1] is None)
    check("9 91% still allows a Read", hook(tmp, "guard_usage.py", {"tool_name": "Read", "tool_input": {"file_path": "x"}})[1] is None)
    check("9 91% allows writing .agent/STATE.md",
          hook(tmp, "guard_usage.py", {"tool_name": "Write", "tool_input": {"file_path": str(tmp / ".agent/STATE.md")}})[1] is None)
    time.sleep(1.1)
    (tmp / ".agent/STATE.md").write_text("# State\nsaved\n", encoding="utf-8")
    r = hook(tmp, "guard_usage.py", probe)
    check("9 91% with STATE saved halts", bool(r[1]) and r[1].get("continue") is False and "State saved" in r[1].get("stopReason", ""), r[2])
    put_usage(tmp, 95, age=3600)
    check("9 stale reading allows", hook(tmp, "guard_usage.py", probe)[1] is None)
    (tmp / ".agent/usage.json").unlink()
    check("9 missing usage.json allows", hook(tmp, "guard_usage.py", probe)[1] is None)


def test_context(tmp: Path) -> None:
    out = run([sys.executable, str(tmp / ".claude/hooks/session_context.py")], tmp, json.dumps({"hook_event_name": "SessionStart"}))
    try:
        ctx = json.loads(out.stdout)["hookSpecificOutput"]["additionalContext"]
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError):
        ctx = ""
    check("10 session_context returns additionalContext", "saved" in ctx and "open task" in ctx and "Continue from NEXT" in ctx, out.stderr)
    out = run([sys.executable, str(tmp / ".claude/hooks/pre_compact.py")], tmp, "{}")
    check("10 pre_compact prints summary instructions", "append-only" in out.stdout and out.returncode == 0)


def main() -> int:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="harness_test_") as d:
        tmp = Path(d)
        setup(tmp)
        os.environ.pop("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR", None)
        for fn in (test_git, test_bash_guard, test_statusline, test_usage_guard, test_context):
            fn(tmp)
    failed = [n for n, ok, _ in results if not ok]
    print(f"\n{len(results) - len(failed)} passed, {len(failed)} failed")
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
